name: Plan a Spring Boot 4 migration with an agent that keeps a todo list
description: A chat agent with the TodoWrite tool. For any request with three or more steps, such as migrating a service to Spring Boot 4, it first writes a todo list, keeps exactly one task in progress, and updates the list as it works through each step.
shortDescription: An agent writes a todo list first and works through it one task at a time.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the TodoWrite tool
One task in progress at a time, with the list updated after each step
Prompt tuned for Java and Spring Boot migration work
idealFor: Java teams planning framework upgrades, and anyone who wants agents to show their plan before they work.
steps: Trigger: a message arrives in the workflow chat.
Plan and work: the AI Agent writes a todo list with TodoWrite and completes it task by task.
Reply: the result is sent back to the chat.
